req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-031 requires GET /players/ to return all players sorted by insertion (id) order. Tests must verify: (1) HTTP 200 status code exactly, (2) all 26 pre-loaded players are returned, (3) the order matches insertion/id order as seeded, (4) the response is a JSON array, (5) boundary cases around first and last elements, and (6) negative path for wrong HTTP methods. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact counts, exact first/last player squad numbers, and exact id values from the known seed data.

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_all_26_players():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_sorted_by_id_insertion_order():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert len(body) == 26
    squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in body]
    assert squad_numbers[0] == 1
    assert squad_numbers[-1] == 26
    assert squad_numbers == list(range(1, 27))

test_get_all_players_sorted_by_id_insertion_order()
